question: What is MarzVerse?
answer: MarzVerse is a digital studio that designs and builds high-performance websites, AI assistants, and business automation systems for startups, service businesses, and growing brands.

question: What services does MarzVerse offer?
answer: We specialize in three core services: 1) Website Design & Development, 2) AI Chatbots & Assistants, and 3) CRM & Business Automation.

question: Who does MarzVerse work with?
answer: We work with startups, corporate businesses, local service providers, e-commerce brands, healthcare providers, salons, and modern companies seeking practical digital growth.

question: Why choose MarzVerse?
answer: We combine modern aesthetic design with practical engineering—building fast, mobile-friendly websites and AI systems that help you attract clients, save operational time, and scale smoothly.

question: What is included in your Website Design & Development service?
answer: We build fast, responsive, and conversion-focused websites featuring custom UI/UX design, mobile-first development, clean SEO-ready architecture, performance optimization, and seamless contact integrations.

question: Are your websites mobile-friendly and fast?
answer: Yes. Every website we build is 100% mobile-first, optimized for lightning-fast load times, and thoroughly tested across all screen sizes.

question: Do you redesign existing websites?
answer: Yes. We can redesign and upgrade outdated websites into modern, high-converting digital experiences with enhanced performance and mobile responsiveness.

question: Do you handle domain and hosting setup?
answer: Yes. We guide you through domain connection, hosting configuration, SSL security certificates, and deployment.

question: What are MarzVerse AI Chatbots & Assistants?
answer: We build intelligent AI assistants trained on your business data to answer customer questions 24/7, qualify incoming leads, support bookings, and provide natural multilingual communication.

question: What can an AI chatbot do for my business?
answer: An AI assistant answers common inquiries instantly, captures visitor contact details, guides users to services, reduces customer support workload, and works around the clock.

question: Can the chatbot speak multiple languages?
answer: Yes. Our AI assistants automatically detect and converse in multiple languages including English, Turkish, Persian, Arabic, German, Russian, and more.

question: What is CRM & Business Automation?
answer: We connect your business tools to organize customer leads, automate repetitive manual tasks, manage booking and follow-up workflows, send automated notifications, and build custom dashboards.

question: How does automation save my business time?
answer: Automation eliminates repetitive tasks like manual lead entry, appointment reminders, invoice tracking, and customer follow-ups—allowing your team to focus on serving clients and closing deals.

question: What is your project process?
answer: We follow a 4-step collaborative process: 1) Discover (understand your goals and scope), 2) Design (plan structure and visual direction), 3) Build (develop and integrate systems), and 4) Launch (test, publish, and provide ongoing support).

question: How long does a project take to complete?
answer: Project timing depends on the scope, number of pages, custom features, and integrations. We provide an estimated timeline during our initial project discovery.

question: How much does a website or AI system cost?
answer: Project pricing depends on the scope, number of pages, design requirements, integrations and automation needs. Share your project details through the Start a Project form for a tailored quote.
